title: API reference
intro: Everything the app does is a route here. JSON over HTTPS, one version: /api/v1.
baseBody: Add /api/v1 to your server's address. Every path on these pages is relative to it.
authBody: Create an API key in Settings under Developer and send it in the x-api-key header, or as a bearer token. The web and mobile apps use their own session.
scopesBody: A key can only do what its scopes allow. A route that needs a scope the key lacks answers 403 with the code missing_scope.
writesBody: Every write needs an Idempotency-Key header. Send the same key when you retry the same write, and the server returns the first result instead of writing twice.
errorsBody: Errors are application/problem+json with a stable code, such as missing_scope or validation_failed. Branch on the code, not on the message.
listsBody: Lists return items and nextCursor. Pass nextCursor back as cursor to get the next page. There are no offsets.
eventsBody: Every write adds an event. Read them from GET /events, or add a webhook in Settings and Retrospend posts each one to your URL, signed in the Retrospend-Signature header.
